BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing cruelty to canines; and amending RCW77.15.240.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.15.240 and 1998 c 190 s 30 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of unlawful use of dogs if the person: (a) Negligently fails to prevent a dog under the person's controlfrom pursuing or injuring deer, elk, or an animal classified asendangered under this title; (b) Uses the dog to hunt deer or elk; ((or)) (c) During the closed season for a species of game animal or gamebird, negligently fails to prevent the dog from pursuing such animal ordestroying the nest of a game bird; or (d) Commands or directs the dog in his or her control to injure orkill a canine for exhibition or entertainment. (2) Unlawful use of dogs is a misdemeanor. A dog that is the basisfor a violation of this section may be declared a public nuisance. p. 1 SHB 2547 (3) For the purpose of this section, "canine" means the members ofthe taxonomical family Canidae that are coyotes, foxes, and wolves.
